title: Artificial Creation (Defect Glass Cards)
description:
Adds two Glass cards to the Defect's card pool. Artificial Creation is based on the concept by u/Suspicious_Badger_18 on r/slaythespire.

[b]Try it now: seed GLASS276.[/b] Start a single-player Defect run with seed [b]GLASS276[/b] and choose Arcane Scroll, Neow's first option. Its random rare card is Artificial Creation.

[b]Artificial Creation[/b] - Rare Skill, 2 energy (1 upgraded).
"In multi-enemy fights, this is Innate. Gain 10 Block. Channel 2 Glass."

[b]Branch Prediction[/b] - Uncommon Skill, Innate, 1 energy (0 upgraded).
"Gain 5 Block. If single enemy: Channel 1 Dark. Else: Channel 1 Glass."

- Artificial Creation checks the enemy count when the fight starts. Branch Prediction checks it when played.
- Channeling into a full queue evokes the oldest orb, as normal.
- Both appear in the normal Defect card pools (rewards and shops). They do not change the starting deck.

Requires BaseLib. Everyone in a multiplayer game needs the mod; live multiplayer hasn't been tested yet.

It also saves local playtest screenshots when Artificial Creation is drawn, played, or offered as a reward. Turn this off with the console command "acrecord off".

Playtest screenshots: https://rrenaud.github.io/sts2-artificial-creation/playtest/run2/
Source and issue tracker: https://github.com/rrenaud/sts2-artificial-creation
changeNote:
v0.2.0
- Artificial Creation is now a Rare Skill: 2 energy (1 upgraded), Innate in multi-enemy fights, gain 10 Block, Channel 2 Glass. It was a 3-cost Power that refilled empty orb slots with Glass.
- New card: Branch Prediction, an Uncommon Innate Skill: 1 energy (0 upgraded), gain 5 Block, Channel Dark against a single enemy or Glass otherwise.
- Playtest screenshots are saved in the background, so dragging the card no longer hitches.
